unresolved_mappings.title: Thrombocytosis (Approach)
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses thrombocytosis; nearest evidence (15-2, Prevention of venous thrombosis) is a generic thrombosis-risk anchor, not a confirmed match.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future MCC objectives-registry refresh adds a platelet-count-abnormality objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Approach to Splenomegaly
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses splenomegaly directly; nearest evidence (2, Abdominal masses and pelvic masses) is a generic mass-workup anchor.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a spleen-specific objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Sickle Cell Disease
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective is titled for sickle cell disease; nearest evidence (42-1, Anemia) covers only the anemia component, not the vaso-occlusive-crisis/emergency content that makes up most of this unit.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds an SCD-specific objective; retain CORE_ACTION depth given the clinical importance of crisis recognition regardless of registry gap.

unresolved_mappings.title: Microangiopathic Hemolytic Anemia / TMA (Definition and Etiology)
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses MAHA/TMA directly; the retained WEAK evidence (15-1, Bleeding, bruising) is a loose secondary anchor, with this unit's actual clinical-action content delegated to SU-H-26 and SU-H-30.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Retain CONTEXT_ONLY depth; no action required since clinical management is captured in the delegated units.

unresolved_mappings.title: Venous Thromboembolism: Diagnosis and Treatment
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses diagnosis/treatment of established DVT/PE; the only related objective (15-2) is titled and scoped to prevention, capping mapping strength at MODERATE despite this being one of the chapter's highest-yield topics.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a dedicated DVT/PE-management objective; retain CORE_ACTION depth and high coverage_weight given clinical importance.

unresolved_mappings.title: Myelofibrosis
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses myelofibrosis; the only loosely adjacent evidence (120, WBC abnormalities) does not name marrow fibrosis or massive splenomegaly.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a myeloproliferative-neoplasm-specific objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Essential Thrombocythemia
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses essential thrombocythemia; nearest evidence (15-2) is a generic thrombosis-prevention anchor.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a platelet-count-abnormality or myeloproliferative-neoplasm objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Monoclonal Gammopathy of Unknown Significance (MGUS)
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses MGUS; nearest evidence (42-1, Anemia) is only relevant insofar as excluding myeloma-associated anemia is part of the MGUS-vs-myeloma differentiation.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a plasma-cell-dyscrasia-specific objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma (Waldenstrom Macroglobulinemia)
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective addresses Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia; nearest evidence (54, Lymphadenopathy) is only an occasional feature of this predominantly hyperviscosity-driven disorder.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a plasma-cell/lymphoproliferative-disorder-specific objective.

note: 9 unit(s) carry WEAK/flagged mapping_strength or classification requiring scope review, out of 51 total study units. All other units achieved STRONG or MODERATE mapping strength with a named or closely-adjacent MCC objective. No MCC IDs were invented and no model-memory evidence was substituted for missing registry coverage, consistent with project accuracy rules. The chapter's most significant structural finding - the H.S22/H.S23 page-misattribution defect affecting SU-H-18 through SU-H-22, SU-H-50, and SU-H-51 - is a source-structure issue, not an MCC-mapping-strength issue, and is documented separately in review_items.json and study_units.json's methodology_note.
